name: Daikokutenbussan Co.,Ltd.
summary: Daikokutenbussan Co.,Ltd. engages in the supermarket business in Japan. It is also involved in the food manufacturing; consulting services related to store development and real estate leasing; trademark rights management; recycling-related work; store cleaning; dairy cow farming; dairy product manufacturing; noodle production; fish farming; raw milk production; vegetable production; import and sale of store fixtures and equipment; wholesale business; sushi and Japanese cuisine provision and sales; fish farming and sales; and vegetable production and sales. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Kurashiki, Japan.
